category_basis: Theodore Wores died in 1939, so life+70 expired in 2009. All works below were also painted/published 1881-1903, independently satisfying the pre-1929 fixed-term rule. Every file is tagged Public domain on Wikimedia Commons, sourced from the Smithsonian American Art Museum, Met Museum (CC0), and other public collections.
